text:
Termites (several species: Microtermes sp., Hypotermes sp., Globitermes sp., and Macrotermes gilvus, collectively កណ្ដៀរ in Khmer), rated as a high-importance pest in this source.

Description: termite colonies include queens, workers, and soldiers, and live in underground nests or mounds. Hypotermes sp. and Globitermes sp. are noted as the species most commonly responsible for crop damage. While termites mostly feed on dead organic matter, they will also attack living roots and stem bases when populations are high, especially in dry conditions or light (sandy) soils.

Damage: termites feeding on roots and the stem base can cause young plants in particular to wilt and die, and can weaken the stem base enough to cause lodging; termites are considered a serious pest of corn in parts of Cambodia, especially affecting young plants.
